fields.title: 📖 When the majority is not the measure
fields.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** رضي الله عنه said:

**"The mass of the Jamāʿah is that which has left the Jamāʿah. The Jamāʿah is only what agrees with obedience to Allah, even if you are alone."**

🌙 **Conclusion:** The **Jamāʿah** is not measured by mere **majority**, but by **truth**, **obedience to Allah** and holding to the **proof**. Whoever stands with the **Qurʾān**, the **Sunnah** and the path of the **Salaf** is not abandoned, even if he appears outwardly **alone**.

immutable.source: 📝 Quellen: al-Lālakāʾī, Sharḥ Uṣūl Iʿtiqād Ahl as-Sunnah wa-l-Jamāʿah, Nr. 160; Ibn al-Qayyim, Iʿlām al-Muwaqqiʿīn, Abschnitt über al-Ijmāʿ, al-Ḥujjah und as-Sawād al-Aʿẓam.
